FIELDS.NAME: The Cutting Edge Salon
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At The Cutting Edge Salon, we provide a wide range of hair and beauty services in a dedicated commercial space, ensuring a professional environment for our clients. Our operations focus on standard salon services including hair cutting, styling, coloring, conditioning, and shampooing, all carried out by licensed and certified professionals in accordance with state regulations. We employ strict health, safety, and sanitation practices to maintain a clean and welcoming atmosphere, and we use only professional-grade products to minimize risks associated with product liability. Our business also incorporates digital appointment management to enhance operational efficiency. The salon is designed to accommodate up to 20 styling stations, allowing us to manage customer flow effectively while mitigating operational risks. Our commitment to customer satisfaction and safety is paramount, as we aim to exceed client expectations through quality services and well-trained staff.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 03/15/2023, a client slipped and fell while exiting the salon due to a wet floor. The incident resulted in medical expenses amounting to $2,500, which has been settled amicably with the client. The status of this loss is closed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Mon-Fri: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM, Sat: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM, Sun: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Heavy-duty safe, class B, labeled for cash and valuables storage.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras installed at all entrances and high-traffic areas, along with routine security patrols after hours.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – The Cutting Edge Salon does not involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous material as part of its operations, focusing exclusively on standard hair and beauty services.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – The Cutting Edge Salon does not sponsor any athletic teams as part of its operations. The focus is solely on providing hair and beauty services in a professional setting.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance, as this is necessary for risk transfer. Certificates are typically checked by the salon management or designated staff responsible for compliance.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions for fraud, bribery, arson, or any related crimes associated with any applicant in connection with this or any other property. The business operates with a strong emphasis on compliance and ethical practices.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – There have been no policies or coverages declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years for The Cutting Edge Salon.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – The Cutting Edge Salon does not lease employees to or from other employers; all staff are directly employed by the salon.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: No – The Cutting Edge Salon currently does not have Workers Compensation insurance in place, which is necessary for compliance with state regulations. This policy should be active to ensure coverage for employees.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – The Cutting Edge Salon does not own or operate any other business, focusing exclusively on its hair and beauty services.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – The Cutting Edge Salon does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. The current policy covers the salon's operations adequately.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – The Cutting Edge Salon is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; our operations strictly focus on providing standard hair and beauty services.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – The Cutting Edge Salon does not rent or loan equipment to others, focusing solely on providing in-house beauty services.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – The applicant has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. They maintain a stable financial status while operating the salon.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – The Cutting Edge Salon does not have exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals, as our operations focus solely on standard hair and beauty services using approved professional-grade products.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – The Cutting Edge Salon does not have any catastrophe exposure as its operations involve standard hair and beauty services without high-risk elements associated with significant disasters.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – There have been no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring at The Cutting Edge Salon. The salon maintains a strong focus on compliance and ethical practices in its operations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – The Cutting Edge Salon does not have any uncorrected fire code violations, maintaining compliance with all safety regulations.
